exposure: RNS System setting adjustments during pregnancy
cohort: 10 pregnant women with epilepsy treated with the RNS System
finding: Pregnant women with epilepsy treated with the RNS System experienced obstetric complications within the expected range, and no major congenital malformations were observed in their offspring.
mod_finding: This study describes obstetric complications in pregnant women with epilepsy treated with brain-responsive neurostimulation, including cesarean section (in 3 out of 14 pregnancies) due to various indications and preterm birth in one pregnancy, but does not specifically compare modes of delivery.
